datasets.title: Housing Material_Bamboo with Mud
datasets.description: Housing materials are part of the Population and Housing indicators in DHS, used to assess household living standards, wealth index composition, and environmental health conditions.The DHS records materials for floors, walls, and roofs. Bamboo with Mud falls under the first Category. Natural Materials These are unprocessed or minimally processed local materials, typically associated with low-income households or rural areas. Floor: Earth, sand, dung Wall: Grass, reeds, palm, bamboo, mud, thatch Roof: Thatch, palm leaves, sod Indicates poor housing quality; usually classified in the lowest wealth quintiles. Reference Frameworks DHS-8 (2023): Population and Housing Indicators - Household Electricity, Flooring Material, and Sleeping Rooms UN-Habitat (2020): Core Housing and Settlement Indicators Framework WHO/UNICEF JMP (2022): WASH and housing infrastructure standards.
